what: Generac makes generators: the standby units that start automatically when the power goes out at a house, portable generators, large commercial systems, and increasingly home batteries and solar inverters.
customers: Homeowners in storm-prone areas, businesses needing backup power, and data centres and telecom sites.
money: home standby, portable and commercial generators in North America
generators and energy equipment outside North America
moat: A dealer and installer network across America that no rival has, plus the brand people name when they decide they need backup power after a blackout.
risks: Sales spike after major storms and fall in quiet weather years, which makes results erratic
Revenue has been flat around $4.2B since the 2022 peak
The home battery and solar business has not met expectations and faces strong incumbents
opportunities: Analysts see about 41% upside, with 18 covering the stock
$415M of free cash flow and only $1.3B of debt
Grid reliability keeps worsening in the United States, and data centre backup power is a growing commercial market
watch: Home standby generator shipments and whether the energy technology business turns profitable.
